barbers.name: Marcus
barbers.bio: Master barber, 10+ years. Specializes in fades and designs.

barbers.name: Dre
barbers.bio: Classic cuts and beard work. Known for clean lineups.

barbers.name: Tony
barbers.bio: Fresh off the chair every time. Kids cuts specialist.

customers.name: Xavier Price
customers.notes: High top fade. Comes in every 10 days.

customers.name: Zion Hughes
customers.notes: Taper, line it up. Shape up every visit.
